prayerExcerpt.en-US: His modesty, mildness, and devotion inspired a love of piety in all who beheld him.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Sua modéstia, brandura e devoção inspiravam um amor à piedade em todos os que o contemplavam.

meta.face: A prince of twenty-three, CLEAN-SHAVEN, with a pale, smooth complexion and a face WIDER at the JAW than at the brow, after Simone Martini's fresco at Assisi painted some twenty years after his death — a smooth, moderate forehead, a LONG, STRAIGHT nose with a broad base, SMALL, NARROW, heavy-lidded grey eyes under faint, level brows, full, smooth cheeks, a SMALL, closed mouth, a BROAD, rounded jaw on a thick neck; short, light-brown hair showing below the mitre; the gaze turned a little aside, quiet and withdrawn. Not the long, narrow oval of his great-uncle louis_france, nor the older, pear-shaped stanislaus.
meta.basis: Simone Martini painted him twice within about twenty years of his death (the Assisi fresco and the Naples altarpiece): a pale young bishop with a broad lower face, long nose and small eyes, the Franciscan habit under a fleur-de-lis cope and the renounced crown. The card follows that type.
